description: This file defines a controller class KpiSaveController responsible for handling KPI save operations within the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It manages the pre-render setup of a Vue component based on request attributes, utilizing traits and classes from the OrangeHRM framework.

classes.name: KpiSaveController
classes.description: Controller class managing KPI save view logic, extending the AbstractVueController and using KpiServiceTrait for KPI-related services.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering based on the presence of an 'id' in the request. Sets component properties accordingly.
